title: Pricing Policy: Sharing a Mortgage Loan File Credit Report Repull Charge After Lock Delays
content:
The borrower's share of a credit report repull charge on a Mortgage Loan File follows who bore the extension days booked on the customer's rate lock extensions. The figures are read from the extension entries of the customer's Rate Lock Commitment: the extension days each extension added and, of those, the days Larkspur bore. The days the borrower bore are the total extension days less the days Larkspur bore, summed across the customer's lock extension entries.

**Clause.** Where the extension days Larkspur bore are more than zero and at least the extension days the borrower bore, the borrower's share is zero and the charge is booked at 0.00; where the days Larkspur bore are more than zero but fewer than the days the borrower bore, the borrower's share is **0.50** (one half); where Larkspur bore no extension days, the borrower's share is the whole charge.

| Days Larkspur bore | Compared with days the borrower bore | Borrower's share |
|---|---|---|
| more than zero | equal or greater | zero — the charge is booked at 0.00 |
| more than zero | fewer | 0.50 (50 percent) |
| zero | any | whole charge |

## Cases (hypothetical Rate Lock Commitment histories)

| Extension entries on the customer's Rate Lock Commitment | Larkspur-borne days | Borrower-borne days | Borrower's share |
|---|---|---|---|
| one 15-day extension, all borne by Larkspur | 15 | 0 | zero |
| a 15-day extension borne by Larkspur and a 15-day extension borne by the borrower | 15 | 15 | zero — Larkspur's days equal the borrower's |
| a 7-day extension borne by Larkspur and a 15-day extension borne by the borrower | 7 | 15 | 0.50 |
| one 30-day extension borne by the borrower | 0 | 30 | whole charge |
| no lock extensions | 0 | 0 | whole charge |
